tools.name: check_ai_visibility
tools.description: Scans how AI assistants see one business: reads its website, writes the buyer questions a customer would ask an assistant, puts them to the models behind ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Grok, and reports how often the business was named, a score out of 100, who was named instead and what holds it back.

tools.name: get_visibility_scan
tools.description: Reads a scan check_ai_visibility started in the last hour, found by the same website, city and category: the result when it is done, or how many answers are in so far. Waits up to forty seconds for a running scan. Starts nothing.

tools.name: ai_index_lookup
tools.description: Reads the AI Visibility Index by AIGROW: for a kind of business and a city or country, which businesses ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Grok name when buyers ask for a recommendation, with each one's share of the answers, the edition and the link to the Index page.
